svg.title: The dining car, seven in the evening, second sitting
svg.desc: A train dining car in the evening with eleven tables and thirty-eight people, a serving hatch with the cook visible behind it, and four tables of strangers.

g.text: The dining car, seven in the evening, second sitting
Fourteen things to find. Four tables have people at them who did not arrive together.
and both of them are looking at a phone
and they have been talking for an hour
